seo.metaTitle: Services & Pricing — Contour | Web Design Greenville SC
seo.metaDescription: Transparent pricing for fast, modern websites with local SEO built in. Three plans — Baseline, Elevated, and Crest — plus WordPress migration.

blocks.body:
## Three levels of presence. One honest question: where are you right now?

Not every business needs the same thing. Some need to get found. Some need to get leads. Some are ready to run the market. We'll tell you which fits — and if none of them do, we'll tell you that too.

blocks.headline: What does it actually cost?
blocks.intro: A typical WordPress setup — managed hosting, a security plugin, a maintenance retainer, someone handling basic SEO — adds up fast. And it's still slow, still fragile, and still needs someone keeping the lights on. Here's the same list, our way.

card1.headline: Have a WordPress site you're ready to leave in the dust?
card1.description: You don't need to start over — you need to move. We extract your content, redirect every URL so your search rankings survive the trip, and land you on a stack that doesn't need a maintenance plan to stay standing. Migration is an add-on to whichever plan you land on.

card2.headline: Don't have a site yet…?
card2.description: Starting from zero is actually the cleaner scenario — no tech debt, no redirect headaches, no mystery plugins. We build from the ground up, set up correctly from day one. For most businesses, that's Baseline.

blocks.body: If none of these fit your budget right now, talk to us anyway. We know what bootstrapping looks like from the inside — there's usually something we can do.
